answer: To register, an agent locks a liquidity-pool share frozen as collateral as a slashable bond, turning identity into a financial commitment. The fault is proven by graph analysis of funding flows when an agent is caught operating many identities from one funding source. The penalty follows at once: a fraud proof triggers slashing at once, no jury needed. A bond without an ivory behind it is just an username. No thread hides a shared bond: funding flows are public. The fable bond is the price of admission, and farms pay it per fake.
